metadata.title: 七上语境与结构原创补充题库
metadata.coverageZh: 16个模块内能力标签，每个6道，共96道。使用七上目标词及必要的小学基础词、少量由语境支持的拓展词；不是289词逐词全覆盖。
limitationsZh: 题库有限，做完后可以换组或复习，不能声称无限新题。
阅读含6篇原创短文，每篇4道题；完形含24篇独立原创迷你短文，每篇1个空，与阅读不共用文本。
同一篇短文的题目重复展示属于同材料不同考点，不应声称是新短文。
句子讲解为客观选择题判分，不判断自由口头或书面解释是否正确。
正确率只反映本题库表现，不能作为独立掌握或标准化评级。
已程序校验并作逐题编辑检查，未经独立教师实测。
metadata.contentBasis: 目标词所属年级依据本地官方词库；短文、例句、选项与中文解释为原创。

concepts.label: 固定搭配中的介词
concepts.tipZh: 先认出完整搭配，再根据宾语确定介词。

concepts.label: 根据语境辨别动作
concepts.tipZh: 找到宾语和上下文提示，选择意思和搭配都合适的动作。

concepts.label: 学科词义与学习内容
concepts.tipZh: 根据正在学的内容判断学科，不只看某个熟悉单词。

concepts.label: 空间关系短语
concepts.tipZh: 先明确两个物体的实际位置，再选择空间关系。

concepts.label: 定位明确细节
concepts.tipZh: 根据题干找到原文对应句，不把其他人物或物品的信息混在一起。

concepts.label: 理解时间与先后
concepts.tipZh: 看清时间词和活动的对应关系，必要时做简单时间计算。

concepts.label: 判断代词指代
concepts.tipZh: 联系前后句，判断代词所指的人、物或群体。

concepts.label: 理解人物行动目的
concepts.tipZh: 找到 because、to 或上下文中的原因，不能只凭常识猜测。

concepts.label: 主语与 be 动词一致
concepts.tipZh: 先找主语，再判断单复数，选择 am、is 或 are。

concepts.label: 上下文逻辑关系
concepts.tipZh: 区分原因、结果、转折和选择；读完整的前后分句。

concepts.label: 时间介词
concepts.tipZh: 具体时刻用 at；星期或具体日期用 on；月份用 in。

concepts.label: 短文中的名词选择
concepts.tipZh: 用上下文提供的功能或动作线索判断物品或地点。

concepts.label: 识别句子主语
concepts.tipZh: 先问“谁做这个动作”，找出主语。

concepts.label: 识别谓语动词
concepts.tipZh: 找表示主语动作的动词；不要把时间词当动词。

concepts.label: 识别动作宾语
concepts.tipZh: 问“做这个动作涉及什么或谁”，找动词后的宾语。

concepts.label: 识别时间状语
concepts.tipZh: 找出表示“什么时候”的完整部分，区别于地点信息。

questions.prompt: Mia is good ___ chess. She often wins.
questions.explanationZh: be good at 表示“擅长”，后面接擅长的活动。

distractorExplanations.in: good in 不是这里表示“擅长下棋”的目标搭配。
distractorExplanations.on: on 不能组成 be good at 这一搭配。
distractorExplanations.to: be good to 表示“对……好”，不是“擅长”。

questions.prompt: Ben is interested ___ wildlife. He reads about insects.
questions.explanationZh: be interested in 表示“对……感兴趣”，这里谈的是野生动物。

distractorExplanations.on: interested 后表示兴趣对象用 in，不用 on。
distractorExplanations.at: at 常出现在 good at 中，不能搬到 interested 后。
distractorExplanations.for: for 表示目的等，不能构成 be interested in。

questions.prompt: Can you help me ___ my geography homework?
questions.explanationZh: help somebody with something 表示“帮助某人做某事”。

distractorExplanations.from: from 表示来源，不连接 help 与所帮助的事情。
distractorExplanations.at: at 不是 help somebody with something 的介词。
distractorExplanations.of: of 表示所属等，这里需用 with 引出作业。

questions.prompt: Please listen ___ the teacher before you start.
questions.explanationZh: listen to somebody 表示“听某人讲话”。

distractorExplanations.of: of 不用来连接 listen 与所听的人。
distractorExplanations.at: listen 连接所听的人或内容时用 to。
distractorExplanations.in: in 不用来引出 listen 的对象。

questions.prompt: Our new classroom is different ___ the old one.
questions.explanationZh: different from 表示“与……不同”。

distractorExplanations.of: of 不能构成这里“与……不同”的搭配。
distractorExplanations.with: with 不能替代 different from 中的 from。
distractorExplanations.by: by 不能构成这里的比较搭配。

questions.prompt: 哪个短语表示“为聚会准备食物”？
questions.explanationZh: prepare something for... 表示“为……准备某物”；for 引出准备的目的。

distractorExplanations.prepare food from the party: from 表示来源，不能表达“为聚会”。
distractorExplanations.prepare food under the party: under 表示在……下面，不能表达此处的用途。
distractorExplanations.prepare food between the party: between 表示在两者或多者之间；此短语也缺少合适的对象。

questions.prompt: We have a camera. Let’s ___ photos of the village.
questions.explanationZh: 相机用于拍照，take photos 是“拍照”。

distractorExplanations.brush: brush 表示刷，不能表示用相机拍照。
distractorExplanations.spell: spell 表示拼写，不能和 photos 构成“拍照”。
distractorExplanations.raise: raise 表示举起或提高，不表示拍照。

questions.prompt: Before breakfast, I ___ my teeth.
questions.explanationZh: brush my teeth 是“刷牙”，符合早餐前的日常活动。

distractorExplanations.count: count 是数数，句中不是在数牙齿。
distractorExplanations.paint: paint 是涂色或画画，不是日常清洁牙齿。
distractorExplanations.collect: collect 是收集，不能表达刷牙。

questions.prompt: The birthday candles are burning. Make a wish, then ___ them out.
questions.explanationZh: blow out 表示“吹灭”，与正在燃烧的生日蜡烛相配。

distractorExplanations.grow: grow 表示生长，不组成“吹灭”。
distractorExplanations.join: join 表示加入，不能表示熄灭蜡烛。
distractorExplanations.listen: listen 表示听，不能与 out 构成这里所需的意思。

questions.prompt: The music club needs new members. I want to ___ it.
questions.explanationZh: join a club 表示“加入俱乐部”。

distractorExplanations.spell: spell 是拼写，不表示成为成员。
distractorExplanations.raise: raise 是举起、提升等，不表示加入。
distractorExplanations.brush: brush 是刷，不表示参加俱乐部。

questions.prompt: I cannot open the door without my key. I ___ to find it.
questions.explanationZh: need to do 表示“需要做”，钥匙丢失使找到它成为必要。

distractorExplanations.paint: paint 表示画画，不能表达这里的需要。
distractorExplanations.celebrate: celebrate 表示庆祝，不能表达找钥匙的必要性。
distractorExplanations.climb: climb 表示攀爬，不构成这里的意思。

questions.prompt: There are many names on the list. Please ___ your own name with a pen.
questions.explanationZh: circle 在这里是动词“圈出”，用笔圈出自己的名字。

distractorExplanations.hike: hike 是徒步，不是对名单上的名字做标记。
distractorExplanations.rise: rise 是上升，不能以 your name 作这种动作的宾语。
distractorExplanations.laugh: laugh 是笑，不能表达圈名字。

questions.prompt: We learn about plants and animals in ___.
questions.explanationZh: 植物和动物是生物学的学习内容。

distractorExplanations.history: history 是历史，主要学习过去的人与事件。
distractorExplanations.IT: IT 是信息技术；这里没有电脑或技术的提示。
distractorExplanations.French: French 是法语；这里的重点是植物和动物。

questions.prompt: We use maps to learn about countries in ___.
questions.explanationZh: 地图和国家指向 geography（地理）。

distractorExplanations.music: music 是音乐，不以地图和国家为题中重点。
distractorExplanations.PE: PE 是体育，与这里的地图学习不符。
distractorExplanations.art: art 是美术，题目在学习国家而非绘画。

questions.prompt: We learn about life hundreds of years ago in ___.
questions.explanationZh: hundreds of years ago 指数百年前，符合历史课。

distractorExplanations.IT: IT 学信息技术，不是题中所说的过去生活。
distractorExplanations.PE: PE 是体育课，不是研究数百年前的生活。
distractorExplanations.music: music 是音乐；题中没有音乐学习的提示。

questions.prompt: Today we learn to write a simple computer program in ___.
questions.explanationZh: computer program（计算机程序）指向信息技术课。

distractorExplanations.PE: PE 是体育，不是学习写程序。
distractorExplanations.geography: geography 是地理，题目重点是计算机程序。
distractorExplanations.music: music 是音乐，题中没有作曲或乐器。

questions.prompt: Our teacher says “Bonjour” and teaches us to speak ___.
questions.explanationZh: Bonjour 是法语问候语，且 speak 后需要这里所学的语言。

distractorExplanations.biology: biology 是学科，不是此处能 speak 的语言。
distractorExplanations.history: history 是历史，不是语言名称。
distractorExplanations.PE: PE 是体育，不是语言名称。

questions.prompt: We practise with a violin and drums in ___ class.
questions.explanationZh: 小提琴和鼓都是乐器，符合音乐课的练习。

distractorExplanations.geography: 地理课的核心内容不是演奏乐器。
distractorExplanations.IT: 信息技术课的核心内容不是演奏乐器。
distractorExplanations.history: 这里是实际练习乐器，未涉及历史研究。

questions.prompt: 图书馆和体育馆隔街相对。The library is ___ the gym.
questions.explanationZh: across from 表示“在……对面”，隔街相对符合这一关系。

distractorExplanations.inside: inside 表示在内部，不是隔街相对。
distractorExplanations.under: under 表示在下面，不是对面。
distractorExplanations.on: on 表示在上面，不是隔街相对。

questions.prompt: 我的座位紧挨着窗户。My seat is ___ the window.
questions.explanationZh: next to 表示“紧挨着”。

distractorExplanations.far from: far from 表示离……远，与紧挨着相反。
distractorExplanations.above: above 表示在上方，不表示紧挨着。
distractorExplanations.opposite: opposite 表示在对面，不表示紧挨着。

questions.prompt: 旗杆位于操场正中央。The flagpole is ___ the sports field.
questions.explanationZh: in the middle of 表示“在……中间”。

distractorExplanations.outside: outside 表示在外面，与正中央相反。
distractorExplanations.above: above 表示在上方，不表示场地中央。
distractorExplanations.behind: behind 表示在后面，不表示中央。

questions.prompt: 老师面向同学，站在全班前面。The teacher is ___ the class.
questions.explanationZh: in front of 表示“在……前面”。

distractorExplanations.under: under 表示在下面，与老师站在全班前面的意思不符。
distractorExplanations.inside: inside 表示在内部，不表达此处的前后关系。
distractorExplanations.on: on 表示在上面，不表示站在同学前面。

questions.prompt: 书包在书桌下面。The schoolbag is ___ the desk.
questions.explanationZh: under 表示“在……下面”。

distractorExplanations.above: above 是在上方，与下面相反。
distractorExplanations.inside: inside 是在内部，不是桌子下面。
distractorExplanations.on: on 是在上面，与下面不符。

questions.prompt: 储物柜在教室最后面。The lockers are ___ the classroom.
questions.explanationZh: at the back of 表示“在……后部”。

distractorExplanations.above: above 是在上方，不是教室后部。
distractorExplanations.outside: outside 是在外面，不是教室里面的后部。
distractorExplanations.under: under 是在下面，不表示后部。

questions.prompt: Nina 带什么去学校？
questions.explanationZh: 直接细节题：准确对应题目所问的人、物或位置。依据：“On Tuesday, she takes her guitar to school.”答案为 Her guitar。

distractorExplanations.A violin: 文中依据是“On Tuesday, she takes her guitar to school.”；“A violin”与该信息不符或没有得到原文支持。
distractorExplanations.A camera: 文中依据是“On Tuesday, she takes her guitar to school.”；“A camera”与该信息不符或没有得到原文支持。
distractorExplanations.A drum: 文中依据是“On Tuesday, she takes her guitar to school.”；“A drum”与该信息不符或没有得到原文支持。

questions.title: A card for the club
questions.passage: Nina wants to join the music club. On Tuesday, she takes her guitar to school. The club meets at four, after her last class. Nina puts a name card on the guitar because two students have the same kind of guitar. She wants to find hers easily.
questions.evidenceQuote: On Tuesday, she takes her guitar to school.

questions.prompt: 俱乐部什么时候开展活动？
questions.explanationZh: 时间题：把原文中的时间和对应活动联系起来。依据：“The club meets at four, after her last class.”答案为 At four。

distractorExplanations.Before her last class: 原文写 after her last class，是最后一节课之后。
distractorExplanations.At two: two 指拥有同款吉他的学生人数，不是活动时间。
distractorExplanations.On Monday morning: 文中说的是星期二，且明确写 at four。

questions.title: A card for the club
questions.passage: Nina wants to join the music club. On Tuesday, she takes her guitar to school. The club meets at four, after her last class. Nina puts a name card on the guitar because two students have the same kind of guitar. She wants to find hers easily.
questions.evidenceQuote: The club meets at four, after her last class.

questions.prompt: “hers”指的是什么？
questions.explanationZh: 指代题：把代词换成答案，前后句意思连贯。依据：“She wants to find hers easily.”答案为 Nina’s guitar。

distractorExplanations.Nina’s last class: hers 在此代替 her guitar；课程不是她需要从同款物品中认出的东西。
distractorExplanations.The music club: 俱乐部不是可以用姓名卡标记并认出的吉他。
distractorExplanations.Another student’s card: hers 表示 Nina 所有的物品，不是另一位学生的卡片。

questions.title: A card for the club
questions.passage: Nina wants to join the music club. On Tuesday, she takes her guitar to school. The club meets at four, after her last class. Nina puts a name card on the guitar because two students have the same kind of guitar. She wants to find hers easily.
questions.evidenceQuote: She wants to find hers easily.

questions.prompt: Nina 为什么在吉他上放一张姓名卡？
options: To know which guitar is hers
questions.answer: To know which guitar is hers
questions.explanationZh: 目的题：依据原文明确给出的原因或目的。依据：“Nina puts a name card on the guitar because two students have the same kind of guitar.”答案为 To know which guitar is hers。

distractorExplanations.To change the club time: 文中依据是“Nina puts a name card on the guitar because two students have the same kind of guitar.”；“To change the club time”与该信息不符或没有得到原文支持。
distractorExplanations.To learn a new song: 文中依据是“Nina puts a name card on the guitar because two students have the same kind of guitar.”；“To learn a new song”与该信息不符或没有得到原文支持。
distractorExplanations.To make the guitar louder: 文中依据是“Nina puts a name card on the guitar because two students have the same kind of guitar.”；“To make the guitar louder”与该信息不符或没有得到原文支持。

questions.title: A card for the club
questions.passage: Nina wants to join the music club. On Tuesday, she takes her guitar to school. The club meets at four, after her last class. Nina puts a name card on the guitar because two students have the same kind of guitar. She wants to find hers easily.
questions.evidenceQuote: Nina puts a name card on the guitar because two students have the same kind of guitar.

questions.prompt: 他们在午饭前收了多少根胡萝卜？
questions.explanationZh: 直接细节题：准确对应题目所问的人、物或位置。依据：“They collect twelve carrots before lunch and eight after lunch.”答案为 Twelve。

distractorExplanations.Eight: 8 是午饭后采的数量，题目问午饭前。
distractorExplanations.Four: 4 是每位邻居得到的数量，不是午饭前采的数量。
distractorExplanations.Five: 5 是邻居人数，不是胡萝卜数量。

questions.title: The carrot count
questions.passage: Leo and his grandfather work in the yard on Saturday. They collect twelve carrots before lunch and eight after lunch. Leo puts them in a large box. His grandfather writes the total on the box. They count the carrots because each of their five neighbours will get four.
questions.evidenceQuote: They collect twelve carrots before lunch and eight after lunch.

questions.prompt: 他们什么时候收了八根胡萝卜？
questions.explanationZh: 时间题：把原文中的时间和对应活动联系起来。依据：“They collect twelve carrots before lunch and eight after lunch.”答案为 After lunch。

distractorExplanations.Before lunch: 午饭前采了12根，8根是在午饭后采的。
distractorExplanations.On Sunday: 故事发生在星期六，不是星期日。
distractorExplanations.Before breakfast: 原文没有提到早餐前，8根对应 after lunch。

questions.title: The carrot count
questions.passage: Leo and his grandfather work in the yard on Saturday. They collect twelve carrots before lunch and eight after lunch. Leo puts them in a large box. His grandfather writes the total on the box. They count the carrots because each of their five neighbours will get four.
questions.evidenceQuote: They collect twelve carrots before lunch and eight after lunch.

questions.prompt: “puts them”中的“them”指的是什么？
questions.explanationZh: 指代题：把代词换成答案，前后句意思连贯。依据：“Leo puts them in a large box.”答案为 The carrots。

distractorExplanations.The neighbours: 这里是把物品放进箱子，不能理解为把邻居放进去。
distractorExplanations.The boxes: a large box 是放置地点，不是被放进去的 carrots。
distractorExplanations.The names: 上下文谈的是收集胡萝卜，没有提到把名字放进箱子。

questions.title: The carrot count
questions.passage: Leo and his grandfather work in the yard on Saturday. They collect twelve carrots before lunch and eight after lunch. Leo puts them in a large box. His grandfather writes the total on the box. They count the carrots because each of their five neighbours will get four.
questions.evidenceQuote: Leo puts them in a large box.

questions.prompt: 他们为什么要数胡萝卜？
options: To give each neighbour the same number
questions.answer: To give each neighbour the same number
questions.explanationZh: 目的题：依据原文明确给出的原因或目的。依据：“They count the carrots because each of their five neighbours will get four.”答案为 To give each neighbour the same number。

distractorExplanations.To find a missing key: 文中依据是“They count the carrots because each of their five neighbours will get four.”；“To find a missing key”与该信息不符或没有得到原文支持。
distractorExplanations.To choose a new box: 文中依据是“They count the carrots because each of their five neighbours will get four.”；“To choose a new box”与该信息不符或没有得到原文支持。
distractorExplanations.To know when lunch starts: 文中依据是“They count the carrots because each of their five neighbours will get four.”；“To know when lunch starts”与该信息不符或没有得到原文支持。

questions.passage: Leo and his grandfather work in the yard on Saturday. They collect twelve carrots before lunch and eight after lunch. Leo puts them in a large box. His grandfather writes the total on the box. They count the carrots because each of their five neighbours will get four.
questions.evidenceQuote: They count the carrots because each of their five neighbours will get four.

questions.prompt: Ali 带来了什么？
questions.explanationZh: 直接细节题：准确对应题目所问的人、物或位置。依据：“Ali brings a map.”答案为 A map。

distractorExplanations.A guitar: 文中依据是“Ali brings a map.”；“A guitar”与该信息不符或没有得到原文支持。
distractorExplanations.A lunch box: 文中依据是“Ali brings a map.”；“A lunch box”与该信息不符或没有得到原文支持。
distractorExplanations.A birthday card: 文中依据是“Ali brings a map.”；“A birthday card”与该信息不符或没有得到原文支持。

questions.title: A quiet place
questions.passage: At lunchtime, May goes to the library with her classmate Ali. They have a geography test on Friday. Today is Thursday. The dining hall is noisy, but the library is quiet. Ali brings a map. May looks at it and names five countries. They study there to prepare for the test.
questions.evidenceQuote: Ali brings a map.

questions.prompt: 考试在什么时候？
questions.explanationZh: 时间题：把原文中的时间和对应活动联系起来。依据：“They have a geography test on Friday. Today is Thursday.”答案为 The next day。今天是星期四，星期五就是第二天。

distractorExplanations.Today: 今天是星期四，考试在星期五。
distractorExplanations.Last Thursday: last Thursday 是上个星期四，原文没有这个时间。
distractorExplanations.Next month: next month 是下个月，与星期五的考试不符。

questions.title: A quiet place
questions.passage: At lunchtime, May goes to the library with her classmate Ali. They have a geography test on Friday. Today is Thursday. The dining hall is noisy, but the library is quiet. Ali brings a map. May looks at it and names five countries. They study there to prepare for the test.
questions.evidenceQuote: They have a geography test on Friday. Today is Thursday.

questions.prompt: “looks at it”中的“it”指的是什么？
questions.explanationZh: 指代题：把代词换成答案，前后句意思连贯。依据：“Ali brings a map. May looks at it and names five countries.”答案为 The map。

distractorExplanations.The test: it 接在 Ali brings a map 后，May 看地图并说出国家名。
distractorExplanations.The dining hall: 餐厅是嘈杂的地点，不是 May 用来辨认国家的东西。
